message: 小さなハルマゲドン
Just past four in the morning, the sky was still shrouded in night.

name: Misa
message: 「What an incredible meteor...」

name: Ria
message: 「Re-Crea is almost here, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Once that's over, it's the Holy Night Festival! I'm so excited♪」

name: Sally
message: 「I'm gonna eat beef bowls! Gonna eat tons of 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「Getting ahead of yourself, aren't you」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't think there's going to be a beef bowl stall, you know」

name: Sally
message: 「Gasp」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka. Are you okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. I think I'll be fine. I've already been seen once, anyway」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Or rather, I realized I'm okay with it. Even if people see me」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey, you two! Stop having a faintly suspicious conversation! You're making me curious!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What's suspicious about it?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Shut up! Anything that sounds suspicious is suspicious!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Jiiya!? Why are you here!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Humble as my abilities may be, I shall lend you my support」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Sally-chan. Brought, food, for you」

name: Sally
message: 「I love katsudon! And I love you too, Oyabin!」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh? Not beef bowls for once, I see」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Katsudon, means win. Good luck. Enough, for everyone」

name: Riesling
message: 「For me as well?」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Eat. Empty stomach. Can't fight」

name: Riesling
message: 「Well then. I shall gladly partake without hesitation.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eating katsudon while watching shooting stars. It somehow feels like a picnic, doesn't it?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Here it comes」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh」
The magic circles remaining at the academy are activating all at once.
The atmosphere begins to vibrate intensely.

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks like we won't have time to eat katsudon」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's alright. We can just eat it once this is over.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You win and then eat it, that's why it's katsudon」
I checked the time.
December 24, 4:24:18 AM.
Ryuusei Town.
The night trembled.
Azel--no, Re-Crea had appeared.
It was simply, utterly overwhelming.
A power different from both the Demon Generals' magic and the Guardian Angels' Spirit Power. A power even clad in chill.
Primordial power.
Still.
I felt neither despair nor resignation.
I could feel the Guardian Angels whispering. Telling us we wouldn't lose.
That as long as there is an unbreakable will connecting life, the world will not perish.

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's Azel... right?」

name: Sally
message: 「Whoa, awesome」

name: Ria
message: 「Azel-san...」

name: Misa
message: 「So this is... Re-Crea...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san...」

name: Azel
message: 「You're still here」
A chilly voice rained down from above.

name: Azel
message: 「If you're going to be reborn, surely your homeland would be better than a foreign land」
Ignoring the rest of us, Azel spoke only to Lolotte.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Azel-san! You don't understand! For the sake of some 'new world' that might not even come, this world and our homeland are going to be destroyed!」

name: Azel
message: 「There is no doubt that a better new world shall come. For that is the will of my Lord」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You've never even met God, so how can you be so certain of that?!」

name: Azel
message: 「I have heard the Lord's words」

name: Azel
message: 「You too should realize the absurdity of defying God, leave that filthy Demon Lord's faction, and calmly await the final hour. That is my mercy toward you, my brethren」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No! I want nothing to do with that」

name: Azel
message: 「It is only natural for the old world to give way to the new. If you are truly my brethren, who take pride in being closest to the Lord, then know that following the Lord's will is the greatest joy」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're so stubborn, Azel-san!」

name: Azel
message: 「All shall be according to the Lord's will」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. It is futile」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Old man...」

name: Riesling
message: 「So long as a person is convinced of their own absolute righteousness, or convinced of their victory, they will never truly listen to what others have to say」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is precisely why conflict never disappears from this world」

name: Azel
message: 「Such a world has no worth in continuing to exist」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not true!」
What fills my body is power.
Hot, as if a sun were shining inside me. Like life itself.

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, it might not be a wonderful world. At least, it's not the best. But we're alive right now! And we want to live!」
The Demon Lord's power wells up within me. No, that's not all.
The guardian angel's power, and everyone's power--all of it sets me ablaze.

name: Azel
message: 「Demon Lord! You petty, filthy existence who defies the Lord's will! You alone shall not even be permitted to be reborn」

name: Synn
message: 「Fine by me if I'm not!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa... He really is the Demon Lord...」

name: Synn
message: 「I told you a million times it was true」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... whatever. Synn is still Synn, after all」

name: Azel
message: 「You darkness that rejects the Lord's grace!」

name: Synn
message: 「If we keep living, there might still be new possibilities ahead of us. Dying means giving up on every single possibility. And we haven't given up yet.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, everyone!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You betcha! I still got a whole ton of stuff I wanna do!」

name: Misa
message: 「First things first, we're going to make the Holy Night Festival a success.」

name: Ria
message: 「I can't obey you, Azel. I have a promise to keep, after all.」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't wanna miss out on eating beef bowls, poo.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Demon World, beef bowl chain, until made, won't lose.」

name: Azel
message: 「Foolish. Truly foolish. Only a death without rebirth is fit for the likes of you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if it only breeds conflict, striving to live is the will of our world!」

name: Synn
message: 「No matter who opposes it, we'll force our way through!」
What fills everyone's bodies is the power of life.
The will to protect this world.

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka.」
I held out my hand.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah.」
Nanaka squeezed my outstretched hand for an instant, let go right away, and grasped the Rosary at her chest.
Everyone was assembled.

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go, everyone!」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Azel
message: 「Perish!」
